title: XPENG IRON humanoid robot draws record physical AI funding
summary: XPENG, a Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer, has raised over $900 million in funding for its physical AI unit at a $6.3 billion valuation to scale its IRON humanoid robot platform, representing the largest single-round private capital raise in the physical AI sector.
problem_solved: Securing massive capital to accelerate the development and scaling of humanoid robot technology for commercial applications.
why_valuable: This record funding validates the growing investment interest in physical AI and humanoid robotics, positioning XPENG as a major player in the next wave of AI-powered automation beyond software.
